# ALFWorld track premise test — Nov 19, 2026

*Generated by scripts/premise_alfworld.py over the AgentInstruct/ALFWorld corpus (336 trajectories, fetched and sha256-verified by scripts/fetch_alfworld_corpus.py; task-type labels from the paper repo). Seed 0. Measurements only; no design decisions.*

Premise under test: gold = same task type with different target_object AND different goal_receptacle (the paper's hard case); distractor = different task type. The design works if structure separates A from B while lexical overlap within A is low (different objects = different words).

## 1. Corpus and signatures

336 trajectories, 6 task types: `pick_and_place_simple` (69), `pick_clean_then_place_in_recep` (68), `pick_two_obj_and_place` (66), `pick_cool_then_place_in_recep` (49), `pick_heat_then_place_in_recep` (47), `look_at_obj_in_light` (37).

Canonical tokens are action verbs only (object/receptacle quarantined as SURFACE args): 302 distinct n-grams over 336 signatures. 37 labels (all `look_at_obj_in_light`) have no goal_receptacle: those rows can join B (different type) and C via same-object, but not A, which requires both receptacles known and different.

## 2. Pair pools

| type |  | possible pairs | sampled |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | same task_type, diff object AND diff receptacle (candidate gold) | 7,258 | 200 |
| B | different task_type (candidate distractor) | 46,588 | 200 |
| C | same task_type, same object or receptacle (easy case) | 1,849 | 200 |

(Same-type pairs with differing objects but a missing goal_receptacle, in no pool: 585.)

## 5. Separations

P(x > y) over all sampled cross-pairs; ties count half. 0.5 = no separation.

| comparison | P | mean gap |
|---|---|---|
| **structural: A > B** (signal exists if > 0.5) | 0.768 | mean(A) − mean(B) = +0.209 |
| **lexical: B > A** (trap works if >= 0.5-ish: gold not lexically privileged) | 0.225 | mean(A) − mean(B) = +0.148 |
| structural: A > C | 0.447 | -0.039 |
| lexical: A > C | 0.159 | -0.227 |
| structural: C > B | 0.806 | +0.248 |
| lexical: C > B | 0.951 | +0.374 |

## Verdict

**Structural separation of A from B: holds.** P(structural: A > B) = 0.768; mean motif score A = 0.530, B = 0.321 (gap +0.209). **Lexical position of gold: P(lexical: B > A) = 0.225**; mean Jaccard A = 0.424, B = 0.276 (gap +0.148). A-vs-C: structural -0.039 (P = 0.447), lexical -0.227 (P = 0.159).
